title: Inspection Crew Rate Card: Items Fee for In-Place Home Resale Re-Inspections
content:
**Rate card — items fee of a re-inspection.** The visit fee of a coming re-inspection on an In-Place Home Resale file is built on an items fee, which enters the visit-fee sum for that visit. The items fee follows the count of standards items the most recent inspection on the file found failing: 6 items or more carry 120.00, at least 3 but fewer than 6 items carry 95.00, and fewer than 3 items carry the package's re-inspection fee.

The most recent inspection is the latest inspection recorded on the file by record date, whether an initial inspection or a re-inspection, and its count is the number of standards items failed recorded on it.

| Items failing at the most recent inspection | Items fee |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 120.00 |
| 3 to 5 | 95.00 |
| 0 to 2 | the package's re-inspection fee |

## Points of reading (hypothetical files)

- Initial inspection on 5 May found 7 items failing; no re-inspection yet: items fee 120.00.
- Initial inspection found 7 items failing; a re-inspection on 9 June found 3 still failing: the re-inspection is the most recent, so the items fee is 95.00.
- Most recent inspection found 2 items failing: the items fee is the package's re-inspection fee.
